accept.title: Network Rules {label}
accept.gateIntro: Before you use MissionHub, read and accept the Network Rules. They set out how members share information, contact candidates and resolve problems.
accept.reacceptIntro: The Network Rules are changing. Read what changed, then accept version {label}.
accept.compare: Compare with the version you accepted
accept.member: I’ve read the Network Rules and I accept them personally.
accept.org: I accept the Network Rules on behalf of {org}, and I have the authority to do so.
accept.languageChanged: The language changed. Tick the boxes again.
accept.versionChanged: A new version of the Network Rules is now in effect. Read it and accept it to continue.
accept.noVersion: The Network Rules aren’t available right now. Try again later.
accept.required: Accept the Network Rules to create your organization.
accept.saveError: We couldn’t save your acceptance. Check your connection and try again.

hold.title: Your organization is on a network hold
hold.body: You can’t open jobs to partners, submit referrals or receive new ones. Referrals in progress continue as usual.

rules.title: Network Rules {label} not accepted
rules.body: {org} hasn’t accepted the version in effect since {date}. Until an organization admin accepts it, you can’t open jobs to partners or submit referrals. Referrals in progress continue.
rules.askAdmin: Ask an organization admin to accept it.

user.title: Accept Network Rules {label}
user.body: Until you accept the version in effect since {date}, you can’t submit referrals or open jobs to partners. Everything else works as usual.

notice.title: Network Rules {label} take effect on {date}
notice.body: Review the changes and accept them before that date.
notice.orgPending: {org} hasn’t accepted yet. An organization admin needs to accept for it.

suspended.title: Your organization is suspended
suspended.body: You can still finish referrals in progress, settle commissions and answer disputes. Your obligations to partners continue.

terminated.title: Your organization was removed from the network on {date}
terminated.body: You can finish referrals in progress and settle commissions and disputes. When everything is settled, your organization’s members lose access to MissionHub.

versions.title: Network Rules
versions.description: The rules every organization and member accepts to use the MissionHub network.
versions.historyCaption: Published versions of the Network Rules
versions.fingerprintHint: A unique code for this exact text, in this language. It shows which text was accepted.
versions.legalReason: Why this change takes effect sooner: {reason}
versions.empty: The Network Rules aren’t published yet.

partner.notTakingReferrals: {org} isn’t taking new referrals right now.
partner.noLongerMember: {org} is no longer part of the MissionHub network.

team.lastAdmin: Your organization needs at least one active organization admin.

errors.acceptanceRequired: Accept the current Network Rules to do this.
errors.partnerActivityRestricted: Your organization can’t do this while new partner activity is paused. Referrals in progress aren’t affected.
errors.settlementUnavailable: This isn’t available while your organization is in settlement mode.

report.title: Report a problem with {org}
report.intro: Use this if you think {org} broke the Network Rules. A report is about behaviour. It doesn’t decide who was first, whether a hire happened or what’s owed.
report.messagesFirst: If it isn’t urgent, you can first try the referral messages. That’s optional.

rightTool.title: Is this about first position, a hire or money?
rightTool.position: Is this about who presented the candidate first?
rightTool.positionText: Objections are filed from the referral within 5 business days of delivery. If the other side files one, you can contest it from the referral.
rightTool.hireTextBefore: Write to {org} in the referral messages. If they don’t answer, email
rightTool.hireTextNoSupport: Write to {org} in the referral messages.
rightTool.amount: Is an amount wrong or unpaid?
rightTool.amountText: Amounts are settled with a dispute on the placement, not with a report.
rightTool.noAnswerText: That isn’t a breach. You can withdraw the referral, or wait for the response deadline.
rightTool.noAnswerTextHiring: That isn’t a breach. You can decline the referral if you can’t move forward.
rightTool.noAnswerTextJob: That isn’t a breach of the Network Rules.

categoryHint.went_around: For example, they contacted your client about the job or fee, or your candidate behind your back.
categoryHint.misused: For example, they used your candidate for other jobs, added them to their database or reposted your job.
categoryHint.shared_outside: For example, they sent a candidate’s resume to another agency or company.
categoryHint.hire_payout: For example, the client hired your candidate and it wasn’t reported, or your payout is late.
categoryHint.false_info: For example, a candidate who never agreed, a fake confirmation, false evidence or a false hire report.
categoryHint.job_terms: For example, no real opening, a stale job, wrong terms, or pressure to change the terms.
categoryHint.discrimination: Unfair treatment of a candidate based on a ground protected by human rights laws.
categoryHint.retaliation: For example, they punished you for a report, accused you in public or reported you in bad faith.
categoryHint.other: Another rule you think was broken.

report.hirePayoutMoney: A report doesn’t collect the money. For an amount, open a dispute on the placement.
report.whatHint: Facts, dates and where it happened. Share only the candidate or client details we need.
report.filesHint: Up to 5 files: PDF, PNG or JPEG, 10 MB each. Only MissionHub platform admins can open them. {org} never sees them.
report.identity: We never show your name to {org}. We name your organization only if they need it to respond fairly. Only two organizations are on a referral, so they may still guess who reported it. Retaliating against a report is a breach (rule 7.1).
report.identityJob: We never show your name to {org}. We name your organization only if they need it to respond fairly. They may still be able to tell where the report came from. Retaliating against a report is a breach (rule 7.1).
report.attest: I’m reporting this in good faith, and it’s accurate to the best of my knowledge. I understand that a report made in bad faith is a breach.
report.filesWaiting: Wait until every file is checked.
report.removeRejected: Remove the file that can’t be used.

errorSummary.one: Fix {count} field to send your report.
errorSummary.other: Fix {count} fields to send your report.

report.sentBody: We aim to respond within 2 business days, by {when} ET. We’ll tell you the outcome.
report.discardBody: What you wrote and the files you added will be lost.

errors.notFound: We couldn’t find this referral or job.
errors.self: You can’t report your own organization.
errors.userLimitBefore: You’ve sent 5 reports in the last 24 hours. Try again later, or email
errors.userLimitNoSupport: You’ve sent 5 reports in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
errors.orgLimitBefore: Your organization has sent 10 reports in the last 24 hours. Try again later, or email
errors.orgLimitNoSupport: Your organization has sent 10 reports in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
errors.attest: Confirm that you’re reporting in good faith.
errors.dateFuture: The date can’t be in the future.

reports.title: Your reports
reports.description: Problems you reported to MissionHub. Only you and your organization’s admins can see them.
reports.orgDescription: Reports sent by members of {org}. Only organization admins see this list.
reports.emptyDescription: To report a problem, use Report a problem on a referral or a partner job.
reports.orgEmpty: No one in {org} has reported a problem.

status.receivedBody: We aim to respond by {when} ET.
status.inputBody: MissionHub has a question for you. Reply below.
status.inReviewBody: We’ll tell you the outcome when it’s decided.

outcome.actionBody: We found a breach and took action under the Network Rules.
outcome.noBreachBody: We looked into it and didn’t find a breach of the Network Rules.
outcome.notEnoughBody: We couldn’t confirm a breach with the evidence we have. You can send a new report if you have new evidence.
outcome.closedBody: MissionHub closed this report without deciding whether a breach happened.
outcome.noChange: This report doesn’t change your referral, your first position or any amount owed.

field.filesNote: Files can’t be downloaded after sending. Only platform admins can open them.

reports.question: Question from MissionHub
reports.replyHint: Answer the question. You can send one reply, with files if they help.
reports.replyClosed: The time to reply ended on {when} ET.

standing.title: Network standing
standing.description: Notices, decisions and sanctions for {org}. Only organization admins see this page.
standing.plannedReview: We plan to reassess it on {date}.
standing.plannedReviewHint: The hold doesn’t end automatically on this date.
standing.suspendedBody: Your organization is in settlement mode.
standing.terminatedBody: Since {date}. Your organization is in settlement mode until everything is settled.

meaning.holdPaused: Opening jobs to partners, submitting referrals and receiving new referrals.
meaning.holdContinues: Referrals in progress, hire reports, invoices, payouts, refunds and disputes. Your internal work: candidates, jobs, pipeline and team.
meaning.warning: A warning doesn’t limit your work. It counts for 12 months if another breach is found.

standing.rulesRowBody: This isn’t a sanction. It ends as soon as an organization admin accepts.

notice.heading: Notice under rules 8.3 and 9.3
notice.intro: MissionHub received information that {org} may have broken the Network Rules. This notice tells you what is alleged and gives you 10 business days to respond. Nothing has been decided yet.
notice.introImmediate: Under rule 9.4, MissionHub put {org} on a network hold on {date}, because of a possible breach of rule {rule}. This notice tells you what is alleged. You have 10 business days to respond. No other decision has been made.
notice.holdEffects: While the hold lasts, your jobs are hidden from partners, and you can’t submit referrals or receive new ones. Referrals in progress continue as usual.
notice.howToRespond: Any organization admin can send one response from your Network standing page, with files if they help. If you don’t respond by the deadline, MissionHub will decide on the record (rule 7.2).
notice.possibleOutcomes: After the response period, MissionHub may decide to take no action, or to give a warning, a network hold, a suspension or termination. If there’s a finding or a sanction, your organization can ask once for a review by a different platform admin.

case.respondHint: Explain what happened and attach anything that helps. Only MissionHub platform admins can open your files. Your response isn’t shared with other organizations.
case.respondConfirmBody: Your organization can send one response, and it can’t be changed after sending.
case.respondedToast: Response sent. MissionHub will read it before deciding.
case.windowClosed: The response window closed on {when} ET. MissionHub will decide on the record (rule 7.2).
case.followupNoDeadline: No deadline. Reply when you can.
case.followupClosed: The time to reply ended on {when} ET.
case.filesHint: Up to 5 files: PDF, PNG or JPEG, 10 MB each. Only MissionHub platform admins can open them.
case.reviewDialogTitle: Request a review of this decision?
case.reviewDialogBody: A different platform admin will review the decision. The sanction stays in effect during the review. Your organization can request one review.
case.reviewDialogBodyFinding: A different platform admin will review the finding. Your organization can request one review.
case.reviewReasonHint: Point to the facts or rules the decision got wrong. You can add files.
case.reviewRequestedToast: Review requested. We’ll let you know the outcome.

review.overturned: Review: decision overturned. The sanction is lifted and won’t count in later decisions.
review.reviewedOn: Reviewed on {date} by a different MissionHub platform admin

errors.closed: The response window has closed. You can’t send a response now.
errors.exists: Your organization has already responded. Refresh the page to see the response.
errors.reviewClosed: The time to request a review has ended.
errors.reviewExists: A review was already requested for this decision.
errors.replyClosed: The time to reply has ended.

decision.title: Decision
decision.decidedOn: Decided on {date} by a MissionHub platform admin
decision.noBreachBody: MissionHub didn’t find a breach of the Network Rules. No sanction applies.
decision.notEnoughBody: MissionHub didn’t find enough evidence to decide that a breach happened. No sanction applies.
decision.residual: Decided using rule 7.4, because no specific rule covered this case.

effects.none: The finding is recorded on your organization’s file. No sanction applies.
effects.warning: This warning counts for 12 months, until {date}. It doesn’t limit your work.
effects.hold: From {date}, your jobs are hidden from partners, and you can’t submit referrals or receive new ones. Referrals in progress continue. The hold lasts until MissionHub lifts it.
effects.holdLifted: The network hold is lifted from {date}.
effects.suspension: From {date}, your organization is suspended and in settlement mode. You can finish referrals in progress, settle commissions and answer disputes. Nothing else is available until the suspension is lifted.
effects.termination: From {date}, your organization is removed from the network. You can finish referrals in progress and settle commissions and disputes until each one is settled. Your organization can apply again after 12 months (rule 9.7).

decision.reviewLine: You can request one review by {when} ET. A different platform admin will review the decision. The sanction stays in effect during the review.
decision.reviewLineFinding: You can request one review by {when} ET. A different platform admin will review the finding.

incident.section: Notices about how a partner handled your information
incident.sectionHint: These notices are about another organization. They aren’t about your organization’s standing.
incident.title: Data incident notice
incident.intro: MissionHub found that a partner organization shared information from your referrals outside its organization. Here’s what we know.
incident.referralUnavailable: A referral you can no longer open
incident.guidance: If your candidate revokes their authorization, the other organization loses access to the shared profile and documents on MissionHub right away. This doesn’t recall copies they already downloaded. Withdrawing the referral keeps your first position. Releasing the candidate gives it up.
incident.guidanceHiring: MissionHub can’t recall information once it has been shared. This notice doesn’t change your jobs or your referrals in progress. If the information is about your client, you may want to tell them.

settlement.pausedList: Candidates, jobs, opportunities, imports, AI features, connectors and API keys, invitations and settings changes.
settlement.continuesList: Referrals in progress, hire reports, invoices, payouts, refunds and disputes, plus Network standing and the team list.
settlement.blockedTitle: This page isn’t available in settlement mode
settlement.blockedDescription: Your organization can only finish referrals in progress and settle what’s owed.
settlement.loadCountsError: We couldn’t load the counts. The links still work.
settlement.teamReadOnly: In settlement mode, you can only deactivate members. Invitations and role changes are paused.
settlement.referralClosed: Referral closed. It no longer appears in settlement mode.
settlement.referralClosedDescription: Closed referrals aren’t shown in settlement mode. Your other referrals in progress are still in the list.
